brief: A tool caddy with a carry handle and divided bins for screws and bits.

requirements.requirement: Divided bins for screws and bits
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2-comp), bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3-comp) provide divided storage; dressed with heap-screws-div2/div3, heap-nuts-div3, heap-standoffs-div3 to demonstrate screws/bits separation

finish.summary: Built L-shaped 4-cell caddy with three divided bins (2x2-compartment + 1x3-compartment) and a top handle on a cover platform over the fourth cell. Joints locked and open faces capped.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
